# Commands graph selected Implementation base and checkout branch choice

Git permits separate branches in separate worktrees to point at one commit; it only rejects checking out the same branch twice. Existing preparation accepts `taskManager.prepare(..., { commRevision })`; explicit base selection needs to resolve and present the commit before preparation. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
